nasa9.description: Selected records exported from the existing local modified NASA9 copy. This logical path is acquisition provenance, not a runtime dependency.
nasa9.provenance_limitation: The full local copy has not been verified against a new official download; its hash is not the hash of the official NASA CEA release.

existing_fixture_cross_check.scope: Coefficient agreement for the overlapping existing fixture only; some local lower interval bounds differ. No claim of full-file equivalence.

janaf_ykb4.provenance_limitation: The original acquisition provenance of the packaged YKB4 tables is incomplete.

major_molecule_reference.scope: Explicit reviewed identities and major-molecule set; JANAF AlH, SiO, Al and Si records; NASA coefficient cross-check.

original_probe.scope: Existing 91-molecule screening and 14 exclusions; archival provenance only, not a runtime dependency.

original_issue_table.scope: Existing 93-row display, explicit source mappings and display flags; archival provenance only, not a runtime dependency.

limitations: The local NASA copy has not been verified against a new official download.
The original acquisition provenance of the packaged YKB4 tables is incomplete.
A unique gas composition is a provisional match, not a confirmed molecular or electronic-state identity.
NASA and JANAF can share upstream sources; agreement is not independent physical validation.
Sampled source discrepancies do not establish abundance errors, uncertainty bounds, or source adoption.
These raw source comparisons are not evaluations of the YKB4 or curated runtime preset domains.

display_policy.description: Screening display only; grades and major-molecule markers are not physical validation, uncertainty estimates, or source-adoption decisions.

historical_migration.scope: One-time numerical checks performed while exporting this fixed baseline. The original ignored results files are acquisition provenance and are not required for replay.

original_probe.comparison: Reconstructed JANAF/NASA log10 ratio from the exported records against the existing probe result.

original_issue_table.comparison: Reconstructed JANAF/NASA log10 ratio at 1500 K from the exported records against the existing Issue table.
